title: Boat & Beach | Benchmark Management Vacation Rental
meta_description: Boat & Beach is a 3.00 bedroom, 2.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: "Boat and Beach" is the perfect location for easy access to Hogtown Bayou and the Choctawhatchee Bay. You're just a quick 10-minute drive from the amazing 30A beaches. Fabulous dining and entertainment options are easily accessible as well. It's a great, quiet place to get the full 30A experience from the bay to the beach.This home is also a dog-friendly retreat, ensuring that your furry friend can join in on the vacation fun. The fenced-in backyard provides a safe and enjoyable space for your best friend to roam and play.This home features 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, making it the ideal retreat for families or groups of friends. In the first bedroom, you'll find a cozy twin-over-full bunk bed with an additional twin trundle, perfect for the little ones. This bedroom shares a convenient hallway bathroom, ensuring everyone has easy access. The second bedroom offers a comfortable queen bed, providing a cozy and private sanctuary for rest and relaxation. Just like the first bedroom, it also shares the same hallway bathroom, making it convenient for all guests.The master bedroom is a haven of luxury with its plush king bed and private bathroom. Unwind and rejuvenate in this serene space, enjoying a peaceful night's sleep after a day of adventures.Sleeping Arrangements - Sleeps 8Bedroom 1: Twin-over-full bunk bed plus twin trundle, TV. Shared hallway bathroom with tub/shower combo.Bedroom 2: Queen bed, TV. Shared hallway bathroom with tub/shower combo.Bedroom 3: King bed, TV. Private bathroom with tub/shower combo.Bedrooms 2 and 3 shared hallway bathroom with tub/shower combo.Bedroom 1 and 2 share a bathroom.Traveling from I-10, take HWY 331 to Chat Holley Rd to avoid traffic.Bay Access:Head north on 7th St., making a left on E. Wilson and then a right onto Highway 393 until you reach Cessna Landing.Distance: .5 miles | Time: 9 minutes walking, 2 minutes drivingCessna Landing:Cessna Landing is a county park on Highway 393 a few miles north of US 98 on Hogtown Bayou. The park has a boat launch, docks, picnic shelters, basketball court, squash court, and playground. Right next door is the Bayou Arts Center, home to the Cultural Arts Alliance of Walton County.Beach Access:Head north out of the neighborhood, turning left onto Ann St. W. and then left/south onto Highway 393. Take 393 until it ends at your beach access, Ed Walline Regional Beach Access.Distance: 4.4 miles | Time: 10 minutes drivingYour stay at Boat & Beach comes with Xplorie’s best activities! one ticket per day, per activity! (over $800 in nightly value) Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!* Parking for 3 cars.* Dog Friendly: If bringing a pet, an additional non-refundable pet fee will be added to your booking. Please contact us if you are bringing a dog. A maximum of 2 dogs is allowed at a maximum of 30 lbs. Please see our rental policies for further details.A Benchmark welcome bag and initial starter kit of amenities are provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, and 1 liner for each trashcan. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of soap/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom, plus 2 washing machine pods.
